title: Nexus SessionViewpoint
description: Viewpoint for an Actor-mode agent-host session. Contains World plus optional binding/branch/event. Never carries an Actor id.

binding_id.description: Required for Character actor_ref; must be omitted for Creator.

branch_id.description: Optional ForkBranch id participating in session isolation.

event_id.description: Optional rewind/event anchor participating in session isolation.
